cases.title: normal saved edit publishes after complete current-generation context
cases.expected_terminal: owner minted for R1/current root+target after publish
cases.oracle_boundary: design-only publisher state oracle; no read/commit

cases.title: resource response ID mismatch rejects
cases.expected_terminal: no owner; resource_id_mismatch; no side effects

cases.title: late old response cannot publish over newer resource
cases.expected_terminal: no owner; stale_generation; newer Store preserved

cases.title: incomplete multi-setter publication does not mint owner
cases.initial_state: resource metadata present but root/view publication incomplete

cases.title: matching cache restore creates a fresh owner generation
cases.initial_state: cache resource R1=current R1;snapshotPublish complete; root=ROOT2,target=VQ2 unique
cases.expected_terminal: new owner on fresh generation; old owner invalid
cases.oracle_boundary: candidate behavior only; cache identity/runtime unobserved

cases.title: cache restore for a different resource rejects
cases.initial_state: cache resource R2,current saved edit R1

cases.title: target deleted, duplicated or replaced invalidates existing owner
cases.initial_state: owner minted; current tree target cardinality 0 or >1 or raw ref changed
cases.expected_terminal: owner invalid; target-specific reason; zero side effects
cases.oracle_boundary: revalidate current root and raw identity

cases.title: principal change from real provider invalidates owner
cases.initial_state: owner minted; provider emits verified principal generation change

cases.title: organization change from real provider invalidates owner
cases.initial_state: owner minted; provider emits verified organization change

cases.title: copy-as-new does not reuse source owner
cases.initial_state: source R1 loaded into copy flow; target ID not yet established
cases.expected_terminal: no saved-owner minted for R1 as destination
cases.oracle_boundary: copy remains Goal obligation; excluded from this contract

cases.title: template and blank create are excluded from saved owner
cases.initial_state: createInit with template or blank root
cases.oracle_boundary: do not map new-document lifecycle to saved resource

cases.title: preview/embed is excluded from editor producer
cases.expected_terminal: no saved-owner minted by this editor producer

cases.title: unmount or mode exit invalidates owner
cases.initial_state: owner minted; unmount or edit-mode exit

cases.title: owner never authorizes source read or target commit
cases.initial_state: valid owner and arbitrary authorization status
cases.expected_terminal: producer performs zero source reads and zero target commits
cases.oracle_boundary: permission allow/deny oracle remains separate and unrun
